title: Billing Office Posting Rule: Monthly Rental Claims for PAP Therapy Equipment
content:
# Monthly Rental Claims — PAP Therapy Equipment

**Posting rule.** Each rental month of a coverage-billed PAP Therapy Equipment device is billed on the anniversary of the rental period, as the class's rental month anchor provides: month 1 starts on the rental period start date and each later month starts on the same day of the following calendar month, falling back to the last day of a shorter month; after a resumption the next month starts on the resumption date.

**Month number.** The month number is the next ordinal after the last paid month — the highest month number among the paid months of the current rental period under the current coverage that have not been reversed, or 0 when there is none.

**Fee and modifier.** Months 1 to 3 carry modifier KH (month 1) or KI and the class's rental fee for months 1 to 3; months from 4 on carry KJ and the class's rental fee for month 4 on. Where the class bills the humidifier as a separate add-on and the device record shows a humidifier included, the humidifier add-on adds the class's add-on fee for months 1 to 3 or for month 4 on, for the same month.

**Allowed amount.** The allowed amount is each fee multiplied by the coverage class's allowed percentage of the fee schedule and divided by 100, each rounded to the cent half up, then summed.

**Whole months.** A full month is billed for any month the device is in the home on its first day; months are never prorated. No month whose first day falls while the record is suspended is billed.

**Billable status.** *Retired: the clause that a rental month is billed only while the device record is on trial or in active rental is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis.*

**Cost share and codes.** The patient responsibility on a paid month is split under the cost-share rules of Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility. Each line carries the class's device code under its method of furnishing, and the humidifier add-on is billed under the class's humidifier add-on code.

## Modifier and fee band by month

| Rental month | Modifier | Device fee band | Humidifier add-on band |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | KH | months 1 to 3 | months 1 to 3 |
| 2, 3 | KI | months 1 to 3 | months 1 to 3 |
| 4 and later | KJ | month 4 on | month 4 on |

## Worked month (hypothetical allowed percentage of 80)

Auto-Adjusting CPAP System (E0601) with a humidifier included, rental month 2. Device: 86.24 multiplied by 80 and divided by 100 is 68.992, rounded half up to 68.99. Humidifier: 25.62 multiplied by 80 and divided by 100 is 20.496, rounded half up to 20.50. The allowed amount is 68.99 plus 20.50, or 89.49.

## Month start dates (hypothetical rental period starting 31 January)

Month 1 starts 31 January; month 2 starts on the last day of February, the shorter month; month 3 starts 31 March; month 4 starts 30 April.

superseded_clauses: A rental month is billed only while the device record is trial_active or rental_active.
